description: Symmetrical wide shot of the modern Putrajaya International Convention Centre (PICC) with a clear blue sky background.
A person standing in front of the illuminated Petronas Twin Towers during sunset in Kuala Lumpur.
A striking monochrome low-angle view of the iconic KL Tower framed against a cloudy sky with structural shadows in the foreground.
Photographers captured inside an elegant corridor featuring classical Islamic archways and geometric architectural details.
Pedestrians waiting at a brightly sunlit pedestrian crossing along a busy Kuala Lumpur street with Hotel Maya in the background.
Black and white architectural shot highlighting the geometry and towering presence of the Public Bank headquarters in Kuala Lumpur.
A red monorail train passing beneath lush green trees, with the KL Tower reflected on the glass façade of a modern skyscraper in Kuala Lumpur.
High-contrast black and white shot featuring the historic Saloma venue framed by modern Kuala Lumpur skyscrapers and Malaysian flags.
A dramatic view from an airplane window looking over a wing floating above a sea of clouds at sunset.
